purpose: Keep rooms and natural spaces geometrically specific before scenery components are selected.
matching_rule: Resolve one primary envelope from the selected environment profile. Explicit profile spatial_envelope may override inference. Monster data never selects the envelope.

low_crawlway.proportions: length clearly exceeds width; ceiling is visibly low enough to feel cramped
low_crawlway.ceiling: low continuous stone/timber overhead plane must remain visible
low_crawlway.openings: one main travel axis with at most one small niche, barred opening, drain, or turn
low_crawlway.focal_zone: monster and one story object occupy the travel lane without turning it into a room
low_crawlway.camera: eye-level or slightly low one-point perspective emphasizing confinement

narrow_built_corridor.proportions: length visibly exceeds width; parallel side boundaries remain readable
narrow_built_corridor.ceiling: continuous built ceiling or arch system should appear in-frame when possible
narrow_built_corridor.openings: one primary travel axis; side doors, niches, or bars remain subordinate
narrow_built_corridor.focal_zone: story hazard or fixture is embedded in the passage rather than floating in open space
narrow_built_corridor.camera: one-point or mild two-point perspective with strong recession
must_show: far turn, doorway, gate, or vanishing depth

built_hall_gallery.plan_shape: elongated chamber wider than a corridor
built_hall_gallery.proportions: noticeably wider than a passage but still organized around a strong long axis
built_hall_gallery.ceiling: visible high or medium-height overhead structure appropriate to the material
built_hall_gallery.openings: one dominant entry/exit axis plus limited side bays
built_hall_gallery.focal_zone: one major furnishing, display, landmark, or story object anchors the space

compact_built_room.proportions: width and depth are comparable; room boundaries should feel close enough to define purpose
compact_built_room.ceiling: one coherent overhead system; not an undefined void
compact_built_room.openings: one principal doorway plus at most one subordinate opening
compact_built_room.focal_zone: one purpose-defining furnishing or landmark occupies a clear wall or center zone
compact_built_room.camera: corner or doorway view that reveals at least three bounding surfaces

circular_built_chamber.proportions: centralized room with radial organization rather than a straight axis
circular_built_chamber.ceiling: domed, vaulted, or circularly framed overhead structure
circular_built_chamber.openings: few perimeter openings spaced around the curved wall
circular_built_chamber.focal_zone: central pillar, well, basin, statue, or floor feature
circular_built_chamber.camera: off-center view showing curvature and central anchor

stair_space.proportions: stairs dominate the composition and create unmistakable rise/descent
stair_space.ceiling: tight stair enclosure or open shaft edge must be defined
stair_space.openings: landings or turns are limited and clearly connected by steps
stair_space.focal_zone: monster occupies a landing or stair run, not flat unrelated floor
stair_space.camera: diagonal or vertical perspective emphasizing elevation change
must_show: landing, wall, newel, or shaft reference

vertical_shaft.proportions: vertical dimension dominates horizontal floor area
vertical_shaft.ceiling: open upward/downward shaft continuation or overhead hoist framing
vertical_shaft.openings: one rim/landing plus optional side access
vertical_shaft.focal_zone: shaft opening is the major environmental form
vertical_shaft.camera: high-angle, low-angle, or cutaway-like perspective showing depth

fortified_threshold.proportions: opening and jambs dominate width; wall mass feels thick
fortified_threshold.ceiling: heavy lintel, arch, or gate structure overhead
fortified_threshold.openings: one primary gate/opening only; guard recesses remain secondary
fortified_threshold.camera: approach view aligned toward or across the threshold
must_not_drift: open hall with no defensive read

collapsed_built_space.plan_shape: formerly coherent built space disrupted by one major failure zone
collapsed_built_space.proportions: original room/passage geometry remains legible around the damage
collapsed_built_space.ceiling: one major breach or failed overhead section, not total destruction
collapsed_built_space.openings: collapse creates one new gap or blocked route
collapsed_built_space.focal_zone: large structural break with few massive pieces
collapsed_built_space.camera: angle that shows both intact architecture and damage
must_not_drift: rubble field with no room identity

natural_tunnel.proportions: longer than wide with naturally or excavated continuous side/overhead boundaries
natural_tunnel.ceiling: curved, rough-cut, or packed-earth ceiling clearly visible
natural_tunnel.openings: one travel axis with occasional side pocket
natural_tunnel.focal_zone: one geological or utility landmark along the route
must_not_drift: square masonry corridor unless profile is built

natural_cavern.proportions: width and height expand beyond a tunnel, with asymmetric rock boundaries
natural_cavern.ceiling: natural roof line visible or strongly implied; not a flat built ceiling
natural_cavern.openings: one or two natural passages/openings only
natural_cavern.focal_zone: one large geological, water, lair, or shrine feature
natural_cavern.camera: three-quarter view showing floor shelf, wall mass, and roof/arch relationship

boulder_void.plan_shape: irregular void between massive angular boulders
boulder_void.proportions: space is constrained by large blocks rather than continuous walls
boulder_void.ceiling: stacked boulders create tight overhead gaps
boulder_void.openings: multiple irregular squeeze gaps but one readable route
boulder_void.focal_zone: one large block or squeeze opening
boulder_void.camera: close three-quarter view emphasizing block scale

sea_cave_envelope.plan_shape: rock chamber or tunnel directly connected to open water
sea_cave_envelope.proportions: one dominant wave-cut opening and broad wet ledge/water edge
sea_cave_envelope.camera: angle showing both cave interior and water connection

forest_clearing_grove.plan_shape: open central ground enclosed by trees or standing natural markers
forest_clearing_grove.proportions: open center is broader than surrounding paths; edge vegetation frames rather than fills it
forest_clearing_grove.ceiling: canopy opens enough to show sky/light gap
forest_clearing_grove.openings: two or three implied woodland exits maximum
forest_clearing_grove.focal_zone: stump, standing stone, sacred tree, or open center
forest_clearing_grove.camera: ground-level three-quarter view with readable enclosure edge

forest_path_edge.plan_shape: woodland path, edge, or pocket organized around one landmark
forest_path_edge.proportions: clear travel or open zone remains visible between large natural forms
forest_path_edge.ceiling: tree canopy or branch framing remains sparse and readable
forest_path_edge.openings: one main path/stream direction plus one secondary recess
forest_path_edge.focal_zone: stream, hollow tree, ruin, bog edge, or root landmark
forest_path_edge.camera: low three-quarter view preserving path/edge depth

ravine_pass.plan_shape: linear natural cut between high side masses
ravine_pass.proportions: depth axis is strong; side walls/slopes visibly constrain movement
ravine_pass.ceiling: open sky unless overhang is profile-specific
ravine_pass.focal_zone: ledge, streambed, bridge, boulder, or pass marker
ravine_pass.camera: long-axis perspective emphasizing side height and route depth
must_show: open sky strip or distant gap

open_landscape.proportions: broad horizontal ground and visible horizon/depth layers
open_landscape.openings: not room-like; routes are implied by terrain
open_landscape.focal_zone: one terrain landmark, ruin, tree, ridge, or structure cluster

riverbank_water_edge.plan_shape: land-water boundary with one readable crossing or bend
riverbank_water_edge.proportions: water occupies one broad shape; banks remain simple
riverbank_water_edge.openings: one main water direction and one bank route
riverbank_water_edge.focal_zone: ford, pool, bridge, root, stone, or bank landmark
riverbank_water_edge.camera: oblique view making shoreline geometry obvious

reef_shelf.plan_shape: broad underwater shelf or terrace beside open water
reef_shelf.proportions: one solid terrain plane plus one open-water depth zone
reef_shelf.openings: one major channel, edge, or drop-off
reef_shelf.focal_zone: coral head, terrace edge, tidepool basin, or seamount landmark
reef_shelf.camera: oblique underwater view showing shelf and open water

kelp_lane.plan_shape: vertical kelp stands framing an open swimming lane
kelp_lane.proportions: tall plant forms flank rather than fill the central lane
kelp_lane.ceiling: water surface or kelp canopy implied above
kelp_lane.focal_zone: open lane with one large kelp/rock landmark

wreck_field.plan_shape: open underwater ruin field organized around one major hull fragment
wreck_field.proportions: one large wreck mass anchors the scene; open water remains around it
wreck_field.openings: hull opening, rib gap, or deck break provides depth
wreck_field.focal_zone: major hull section, mast, anchor, or rib structure

open_water_dropoff.plan_shape: open aquatic space organized around one boundary feature
open_water_dropoff.openings: depth is conveyed by drop, roots, vent field, or horizon
open_water_dropoff.focal_zone: drop edge, root arcade, or vent chimney
open_water_dropoff.camera: oblique view with clear depth plane
must_not_drift: closed cave unless profile says cave

graveyard_field.plan_shape: exterior burial ground with a readable path among sparse markers
graveyard_field.proportions: open path/ground areas remain larger than grave-marker clusters
graveyard_field.ceiling: open sky with optional sparse tree framing
graveyard_field.openings: path bends toward gate, mausoleum, or deeper graves
graveyard_field.focal_zone: gate, mausoleum, large marker, or dead tree

sacred_built_space.proportions: space organizes toward one ritual focal point
sacred_built_space.ceiling: arch, canopy, broken roof, or open sacred sky condition must be explicit
sacred_built_space.openings: one ceremonial approach and limited side openings
sacred_built_space.focal_zone: altar, plinth, idol, sacred tree/stone, or ritual basin
sacred_built_space.camera: approach or three-quarter view preserving focal hierarchy
must_not_drift: random ruin with no sacred read

giant_hall_envelope.proportions: doors, stairs, furnishings, and masonry visibly exceed ordinary humanoid scale
giant_hall_envelope.ceiling: very high overhead structure with broad beams/arches
giant_hall_envelope.camera: low angle or wide three-quarter view emphasizing scale
must_show: at least one unmistakable scale cue

dragon_lair_space.plan_shape: large creature habitat organized around one resting, hoard, perch, or territorial zone
dragon_lair_space.proportions: dragon-scale landmark and open body space dominate
dragon_lair_space.ceiling: family/profile-specific sky, cave roof, roots, or caldera walls
dragon_lair_space.openings: one or two enormous movement routes
dragon_lair_space.focal_zone: nest, perch, hoard, lava channel, root island, or relic
dragon_lair_space.camera: wide three-quarter view preserving full creature silhouette
